gloss: opening ceremony (of a season or event)

definitions.gloss: opening ceremony (of a season, league or festival)
definitions.explanation: A ceremony held to mark the start of a season, a league, a festival or a run of events.

examples.japanese: {開幕式|かいまくしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
{開幕式|かいまくしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{宣誓|せんせい}した→宣誓する：22627_senseisuru⟧。
examples.english: At the opening ceremony, a representative of the players took the oath.

examples.japanese: ⟦リーグ→リーグ：11600_riigu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開幕式|かいまくしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧そろって⟦{入場|にゅうじょう}→入場：03521_nyuujou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Players from every team marched in together at the league's opening ceremony.
